tickets.name: Center Circle
tickets.note: Anthony Davis to score the first basket of WAS at CLE. Davis takes the jump ball, and win the tip, take the first swing, that's how this game gets going! The opening possessions are his playground, and he came to play! The book has him priced like a bench guy. Pinch me, we'll take that all night long! One of 2 in WAS@CLE (Davis, Watson): stakes are split so whichever scores first covers the game.
